incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P1 — elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-runtime-us-east-1. 5xx-rate=18% (baseline ~0.5%). Alerts: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/inf-runtime-17625 :pager: 

ana: ack, oncall here, grabbing logs and metrics now. marking as on-call lead.

mike: any known customer-facing impact?

lisa-cs: Customer AcmeProd and a handful of PLG signups seeing 502 / gateway errors, some 1-1 chat completions failing. CS opened ticket #1234 and asked for status update.

cheng: looked at pod logs — model-runner processes are crashing with segfaults, followed by OOM kills on the same host. sample tail: ```
[2026-03-15T18:07:21Z] model-runner[pid=2431]: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f9c6a...
[2026-03-15T18:07:21Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 2431 (model-runner) total-vm:1500000kB, anon-rss:1200000kB
[2026-03-15T18:07:22Z] model-runner[pid=2450]: starting worker for model:redwood/longform-7b-quant
```

eva: confirmed same pattern across 3 pods in the pool. likely a memory regression in the quant path or a bad kernel/userland interaction with the new attention kernel.

ana: initial mitigation plan: 1) reduce batch size to 1 for high-memory models, 2) temporarily route 25% traffic to fallback model variant (half-precision / smaller context), 3) scale node pool +2, 4) restart affected pods to flush corrupted KV caches. I'll run them now.

sre-lead: +1. also consider disabling KV cache for the short term — we've seen cache-corrupt OOM cascades before. set routing to fallback before rolling restarts to avoid spike.

mike: doing routing change via admin API: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":{"fallback":"redwood/longform-7b-quant-safe","percent":25}}'
```

deploy-bot: routing change applied by mike at 176250
